canonicalDerivationBanner.explanation: This script performs an MLE fit on (eta, sigma) against the Bujack et al. 2022 PNAS color-perception dataset. The fit is an EXTERNAL VALIDATION of the QOU prediction (eta_QOU_predicted = 0.10428, derived canonically from q_0 = 1.1097), NOT a framework calibration. eta is predicted from the substrate parameter; sigma is observer-side nuisance with no upstream consumer. Per prop:three-calibration-discipline, the framework retains exactly three calibrations (q, alpha_3, alpha_5); this fit does not introduce a fourth.

description: MLE fit of the QOU one-parameter non-Riemannian color-perception model d_perc(d) = arsinh(eta * d) / eta to the Bujack et al. 2022 PNAS Gray-experiment triad-choice dataset (github.com/lanl/color). Two free parameters: eta (substrate deformation, predicted ~0.1043 from q_0 ~ 1.1097) and sigma (Thurstonian observer noise). Reports MLE, parametric bootstrap 95% CI on eta, Riemannian-vs-QOU likelihood-ratio test, and a three-way verdict against the prediction bands in the block.
